---
title: "Exams"
---

Past year exam papers.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
import coursesite as S

exams = sorted(Path("TestsExams").glob("*.pdf"), key=lambda p: p.name.lower())

if not exams:
    print("_No exam papers available yet._")
else:
    lines = [
        f"- {S.link(str(p), p.stem)}"
        for p in exams
    ]
    print("\n".join(lines))
```
